objective: Maximize supported-class validation macro AP; require improvement greater than 0.0001 over recovered five-second baseline; exact ties prefer simpler earlier policy
split: Existing maestro-portfolio-v1 recording split, 29 train / 10 validation / 10 already-observed test recordings
evaluation_status: Test is previously observed. Do not load test labels or inspect new test metrics until final policy is committed. No untouched/generalization claim.

stage1.hypothesis: Averaging existing learned heads reduces prediction variance without more model fitting
stage1.components: Three original central-second heads and three one-third-learning-rate central-second heads, all already selected by validation epochs
stage1.selection: Validation AP; earlier candidate wins exact ties

stage2.hypothesis: Adjacent seconds share acoustic context; within-recording smoothing may improve event consistency
stage2.boundaries: Reset on recording changes or nonconsecutive second indices; normalize box kernel at edges; labels and annotation masks are never smoothing inputs
stage2.latency: Centered windows add future context; EWMA is causal in probabilities, but inherited encoder context may remain offline

stage3.hypothesis: Complementary one- and five-second representations may improve validation AP through a fixed convex ensemble
stage3.gpu_justification: The five-second embedding/prediction cache was not retained; regenerating frozen validation predictions is necessary to compare against the stronger existing baseline
stage3.candidates: Mix recovered five-second winner with stage2 winner using central weights 0, 0.25, 0.5; apply either no additional smoothing or centered box 3 seconds. Include recovered five-second baseline and all previous stage winners.
stage3.compute: CPU cached work first. At most one new private free GPU run, hard stop 900 seconds, fail without GPU. Mount original private heads/encoder/caches. Fetch authentic full licensed source once but compute only validation predictions before selection. No retraining. Compute observed-test predictions only after saved selection.
stage3.baseline_replay_guard: Recovered five-second validation AP must match historical baseline within 0.0001; otherwise stop and preserve discrepancy

thresholds: After AP selection, choose per-class thresholds on validation F1 using existing grid; unsupported validation classes retain 0.5
production: If validation beats recovered five-second baseline by more than 0.0001, save component states, context contracts, convex weights, smoothing stages, class order, training normalizations and validation thresholds in a versioned checkpoint; otherwise retain original winner
checks: Masks unchanged and absent from transformations
No data, embeddings or weights public
stopping: Finish at most these three stages, preserve failed hypotheses and all scores, then stop and return to parent for publication and pause
limitations: Additional reuse of the same small validation split increases selection optimism
One seed and correlated windows; no statistical superiority claim
Previously observed test cannot become independent evidence
Smoothing can suppress brief events and introduce additional offline latency
No guarantee of finding a gain; no class-specific test-guided correction
MAESTRO custom noncommercial and original encoder licensing continue to apply
